Running command: cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "fuzzing/format_command_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 41, "var": "data", "code": "if (size < 3) return 0;", "note": "Attacker-controlled input must be at least 3 bytes to proceed; input is '%qa' (3 bytes)."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "fuzzing/format_command_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 44, "var": "new_str", "code": "new_str = malloc(size+1); memcpy(new_str, data, size); new_str[size] = '\\0';", "note": "Input bytes are copied into a NUL-terminated heap buffer new_str, which becomes the format string."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "fuzzing/format_command_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 51, "var": "cmd", "code": "redisFormatCommand(&cmd, new_str);", "note": "Uninitialized pointer cmd is passed by address to redisFormatCommand; on failure cmd is never set to NULL."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "hiredis.c", "function": "redisFormatCommand", "line": 551, "var": "format", "code": "len = redisvFormatCommand(target, format, ap);", "note": "The format string '%qa' is forwarded to redisvFormatCommand for parsing."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "hiredis.c", "function": "redisvFormatCommand", "line": 306, "var": "c", "code": "const char *c = format;", "note": "Parser starts scanning the format string; curarg is allocated via sdsempty()."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "hiredis.c", "function": "redisvFormatCommand", "line": 327, "var": "c", "code": "if (*c != '%' || c[1] == '\\0')", "note": "At position 0, *c == '%' and c[1] == 'q' (not NUL), so the else branch handles the format specifier."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "hiredis.c", "function": "redisvFormatCommand", "line": 354, "var": "c[1]", "code": "switch(c[1])", "note": "c[1] == 'q' does not match 's', 'b', or '%', so control falls to the default printf-format detection branch."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "hiredis.c", "function": "redisvFormatCommand", "line": 449, "var": "_p", "code": "goto format_err;", "note": "After parsing flags/width/precision, 'q' is not a valid integer or double conversion and has no valid size modifier, so the format is invalid and jumps to format_err."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "hiredis.c", "function": "redisvFormatCommand", "line": 522, "var": "target", "code": "cleanup: ... return error_type;", "note": "Cleanup frees curarg/curargv/cmd but does NOT set *target = NULL; the caller's cmd pointer remains uninitialized."},
  {"step": 10, "file": "hiredis.c", "function": "redisFormatCommand", "line": 556, "var": "len", "code": "if (len < 0) len = -1; return len;", "note": "redisvFormatCommand returned -2, which is coerced to -1; redisFormatCommand returns failure without touching *target."},
  {"step": 11, "file": "fuzzing/format_command_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 53, "var": "cmd", "code": "if (cmd != NULL) hi_free(cmd);", "note": "Since redisFormatCommand failed without setting cmd to NULL, cmd still holds an uninitialized garbage pointer; the NULL check passes and hi_free(cmd) frees an invalid pointer, causing a crash."}
]
EOF
echo "Trace created" && python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')); print('Valid JSON')"
